claims.summary: Technical delivery and exact reply lineage do not establish uptake, felt effect, or continued consent.
claims.disposition: Retain these as separate typed states and keep felt effect false in machine receipts.

claims.summary: A control command needs exact actor, target, deployment, revision, expiry, and evidence lineage.
claims.disposition: Implement those fields in the signed intent and command contract.

claims.summary: Receipts must disclose clamping, applied values, previous values, and rollback lineage.
claims.disposition: Implement SelfControlReceiptV2 with requested, clamped, applied, previous, expiry, and rollback fields.

claims.summary: Peer-impacting semantic gain or sensory admission cannot inherit authority from correspondence or silence.
claims.disposition: Require two current scoped signatures and preserve silence as neutral.
